figure5_semantics: F and Phi are frame means under a common maximum scalar budget. Working-point x coordinates are sequence maxima, y coordinates are mean tau. Open markers use LCA filling, filled markers use optimal filling of the same order. The implemented orders need not attain F at their global budget.
figure7_semantics: Four achieved settings P, R2, R20, R100. NROE is the frame mean. Scalar cost shows the mean and maximum NMLE. Motion error uses spatial and projected clear-event sets separately. Kappa is an eligibility threshold, not a bound on achieved NMLE.
